target.statement: MMPAD average VUS-PR of 0.4399 on the univariate TSB-AD evaluation track (top of leaderboard)

compute.basis: Requires downloading the full TSB-AD univariate benchmark (350 series, some very long), running the exclusion-zone-aware kNN matrix-profile self-join on every series with the tuned k=5 and autocorrelation-inferred m, then computing VUS-PR with the benchmark metric code; matrix-profile self-joins are O(n^2) per series and dominate runtime on CPU.

blockers: Full 350-series univariate evaluation is heavy for a laptop within a few hours
Hyperparameter m is inferred via autocorrelation estimator that must be matched to benchmark code
VUS-PR metric implementation must be taken from TSB-AD repo and matched exactly
Code release is a submission repo; exact configs/scripts for reproducing the aggregate number may be incomplete
title: Matrix Profile for Time-Series Anomaly Detection: A Reproducible Open-Source Benchmark on TSB-AD
